newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 94,000 MT were off 21 percent from the previous week, but exceeded the 4-week average by 13 percent. Major increases for the Philippines (44,500 MT), Indonesia (41,500 MT), Egypt (29,000 MT), and Turkey (14,300 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (71,400 MT).

Exports of 179,200 MT were 42 percent below the previous week and 18 percent below the 4-week average. China (48,200 MT), Indonesia (41,500 MT), Egypt (29,000 MT), and Turkey (14,300 MT) were the major recipients
